preconditions.description: The number of polyhedrons n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s in ['Tetrahedron', 'Cube', 'Octahedron', 'Dodecahedron', 'Icosahedron'] for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each polyhedron name in the input is one of the five valid types.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum({'Tetrahedron': 4, 'Cube': 6, 'Octahedron': 8, 'Dodecahedron': 12, 'Icosahedron': 20}[s] for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of faces of all polyhedrons in the collection.
